summary: EF 宣布 Glamsterdam 将于 10 月 26 日 17:42:48 UTC 在 Hoodi 激活，同时把 gas 上限提到 200M。lightclient 提出两项 EIP-7906 改动：frame 模式 POST_TX 改名为 ASSERT，删去 TXDIFF 并把部分功能并入 TXTRACE。Vitalik 把 zkAPI、Tor、掩护流量和本地 LLM 改写提示词组合成代理的“paranoid mode”。

items.title: EIP-7906 PR：把 POST_TX 改名为 ASSERT
items.note: （lightclient）。理由是 EIP-8141 的 frame 模式都用一个词描述“做什么”，POST_TX 描述的是位置，ASSERT 描述意图。
items.title_en: EIP-7906 PR: rename POST_TX to ASSERT
items.note_en: (lightclient). The reasoning: every EIP-8141 frame mode is one word describing what happens; POST_TX describes where the logic sits, while ASSERT describes what the frame intends to do.

items.note: 激活于 epoch 132,352、slot 4,235,264（10 月 26 日 17:42:48 UTC），同一 epoch Hoodi gas 上限升到 200M。核心是 ePBS（EIP-7732）与 BAL（EIP-7928）；gas 方面 EIP-8037 提高并单独计量状态创建成本，EIP-8038 更新状态访问成本。依赖固定 gas stipend、硬编码 gas 上限或剩余 gas 假设的合约可能需要修改。
items.title_en: EF Blog: Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet announcement
items.note_en: . Activation is at epoch 132,352, slot 4,235,264 (17:42:48 UTC on October 26), and Hoodi's gas limit rises to 200M at the same epoch. The headliners are ePBS (EIP-7732) and BALs (EIP-7928). On gas, EIP-8037 raises and separately meters the cost of creating state, and EIP-8038 updates state access costs. Contracts that rely on fixed gas stipends, hardcoded gas limits or assumptions about remaining gas may need changes.

summary_en: The EF announced that Glamsterdam will activate on Hoodi at 17:42:48 UTC on October 26, with the gas limit raised to 200M at the same time. lightclient proposed two EIP-7906 changes: the POST_TX frame mode becomes ASSERT, and TXDIFF is removed with some of its functionality folded into TXTRACE. Vitalik combined zkAPI, Tor, cover traffic and local LLM prompt rewriting into a "paranoid mode" for his agent.
